development: Existing video pilot and seed 2026102001 scenes. Both are development data, never qualification evidence.
screening: New synthetic seed 2026102002. Related renderer families shared with development; not source-disjoint real-world qualification.
arms: local schema request plus grounding prompt
public_contract: Caller-defined nullable fields and types. No expected values, const or gold enums. Native receives the same contract in its prompt. Unconstrained local retains the question but omits the schema request and grounding instruction.
scoring: Identical strict JSON/schema validation and exact-field correctness for all arms; no key repair, no host correction, reject length stops.

shadow_workflow.selection: First four frozen cases in each screening category, fixed before results.
shadow_workflow.route: Current conservative policy: native primary in every case; optional matching-model image shadow. Local runs first; native sees original pixels and no shadow text.
shadow_workflow.interpretation: This measures current shadow overhead, not a qualified local-accepting router. No claim of savings from zero hosted tokens on direct-local arms.

decision: Do not modify prompts, schemas, routing or scoring after screening starts. Preserve failures for future models. No production promotion without independent quality and paired end-to-end efficiency gates.
